features: The name huge over a full-screen photo of a finished building

name: Atelier Voss
short: An architecture practice whose four projects sit beside the drawings that made them.
long: The name runs huge across a photo of a finished house. Below it, four projects each get a full chapter: the real building on one side, and on the other the plan, section or elevation drawing itself in as you scroll. Tap a number on the drawing and the same spot lights up on the photo. Enquiries go in on the practice's own title block.
proves: Real photography and technical drawing on the same page, so a visitor sees both the finished building and the thinking behind it.
story: An architect sells the drawing and the building. This site shows both, side by side, and links them point by point.
